messages:
Jamal: Heads up — planning a late-night deploy Friday 2026-03-26 00:30-02:00 UTC. This patch touches three areas: runtime KV eviction default tweak (reduces retention to 30s for idle shards), console schema migration (schema v3 -> v4, safe-additive mostly), and a router header-split flag flip. Need cross-service coord, pin requests, and clear rollback criteria. Link to release notes: https://go/release/kv-evict-console-v4

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy submitted by Jamal. Wave plan: canary=10% (10m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (rolling). Auto-rollback on 5xx spike >3x baseline or P95 latency >200ms for >5m. Runbook: /playbooks/deploy-wave-ops

Maria: @Chris @Sophia @Alex can you confirm service owners? Also we need pinned variants for the canary window — please pin if you want a hard hold. I want a manual hold step after 50% before full roll.

Chris: Runtime owner here. I'll pin runtime binary to 2.1.4-evict30 for the window. Command I'll run: `deploybot pin --service=runtime --version=2.1.4-evict30 --until=2026-03-26T06:00:00Z` Will also enable verbose kv metrics during canary (:eyes:).

Sophia: Console owner. Schema migration is backwards-compatible except one enum rename. We'll ship v4 behind a feature flag `console.schema.v4`. I'll coordinate a schema toggle at 50% hold. Release notes PR: https://go/release-notes/console-v4

Alex: Router here. Header-split flag flip may affect some internal clients that still send legacy X-RD-User header. I'll add a header shim for one release to translate old->new. Will pin router to `router-5.12.0-shim` for the night and keep the shim enabled until we confirm no client errors.

Ben: Oncall chiming in. Rollback criteria: if deploy-bot triggers auto-rollback we accept. Manual rollback triggers: repeated 503s in >3 pods across regions, or any 500s in the console UI path that blocks admin flows. Also need an explicit rollback playbook step that includes DB migration revert for the enum rename (Sophia, confirm revert path).

Sophia: Revert path: enum rename is safe-additive in the DB (we add new enum label, write guarded code). To rollback we switch feature flag back and run `schema:rollback-enum` job (idempotent). I'll post exact command in the runbook now.

Maria: Good. Can people add the pin commands in this thread once done (so audit log lives here)? Also add a short blurb in release notes about the router shim and why. I'm locking the manual hold after 50% — will only proceed on 👍 from all owners.

Chris: Pinned runtime: `deploybot pin --service=runtime --version=2.1.4-evict30 --until=2026-03-26T06:00:00Z` ✅

Alex: Pinned router: `deploybot pin --service=router --version=5.12.0-shim --until=2026-03-26T06:00:00Z` ✅ Shim will be active.

Sophia: Console feature flag pre-created and pinned route: `deploybot pin --service=console --flag=console.schema.v4 --until=2026-03-26T06:00:00Z` Posted schema rollback command in runbook.

deploy-bot: Pins recorded. Canary window starts 2026-03-26T00:30:00Z UTC. Monitoring hooks: perf, errors, tracing traces for cross-service latency. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

Jamal: Quick checklist before start: 1) Owners pinned (yes) 2) Runbook link in deploy ticket (yes) 3) Canary dashboards up (Chris, Ben please confirm) 4) Manual hold at 50% (Maria) 5) Rollback commands validated (Sophia confirmed). If no objections I'll kick off at 00:30 UTC.

Ben: Dashboards LGTM. I added a synthetic that exercises header split and admin console flows. Will watch during canary.

Maria: I'm standing by for the manual go/no-go at 50%. If anyone sees regressions, call the rollback and post reason here.

Chris: Verbose KV metrics enabled. Will post canary metrics snippets every 10m.

Alex: Router shim logs will include `shim.translate=1` tag. I'll watch for translation errors.

Jamal: Thanks all. Posting final release note blurb: "Runtime: eviction tuning (30s idle), Console: schema v4 behind feature flag, Router: temporary header shim to translate legacy headers. Canary + manual hold at 50% — owners pinned." Will start at 00:30 UTC unless you tell me otherwise. :white_check_mark:
